query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM rb_team_puzzle tp
            JOIN rb_puzzle p ON p.id = tp.puzzle_id AND p.round_id = $2
            JOIN rb_game g ON g.id = p.game_id
            WHERE tp.team_id = $1 AND tp.state >= 0
                AND COALESCE(p.release_at, g.start_at) <= NOW()
        );
